Massive fire at Bangkok pub kills at least 27 people

nary_nodes.label: Bangkok pub fire
evidence: A massive fire in a Bangkok bar late Sunday night killed at least 27 people and injured dozens, sending screaming patrons fleeing as flames shot from the entrance, according to officials and video verified by AFP.

nary_nodes.label: Chadchart Sittipunt's statement on fire
evidence: "The fire spread very quickly, reaching up to the ceiling. Smoke was likely the main cause of death," Bangkok Governor Chadchart Sittipunt told reporters outside the venue on the outskirts of the Thai capital.
He said 27 people were killed and 63 were hospitalised with injuries, including 22 in critical condition, adding that authorities had launched an investigation.

nary_nodes.label: Belief on fire exit obstructions
evidence: A number of the victims were found near the fire exit and authorities believe there may have been obstructions blocking it, he said.

evidence: "I heard loud screaming from a lot of people inside – chaos happened," Laotian tourist Kan Kutirat told AFP.

nary_nodes.label: Kan Kutirat noticed smoke
evidence: Kan said he was drinking alone at the bar at around 10:00pm on Sunday when he noticed smoke rising near the stage.

nary_nodes.label: Kan Kutirat's experience
evidence: "I never experienced anything like this before," he said.

nary_nodes.label: Kan Kutirat's images stuck in mind
evidence: "The images are still stuck in my mind," he said.

nary_nodes.label: Kan Kutirat helped a woman
evidence: He said he helped carry a woman out of the bar.

nary_nodes.label: Kan Kutirat's Facebook post
evidence: On his post, he added: "I could only get one person out. I tried my best. I'm sorry."

nary_nodes.label: Fire brought under control
evidence: Thai national police said in a social media post at around 2:00am Monday (1900 GMT) that the fire had been "brought under control".

nary_nodes.label: Musicians' description of fire origin
evidence: He said musicians at the venue described "smoke from a circuit breaker near the stage followed by the power going out and an explosion".

nary_nodes.label: Anutin Charnvirakul on victims' movement
evidence: "Most of the victims ran to the back, to toilets with no exit. It could be because of panic because there was fire and smoke in the restaurant," Anutin told reporters.

evidence: He gave the same death toll, 27, while local police also confirmed to AFP the same number.
